summary: Iteration 24 - Full 3-phase launch testing: Role system, route protection, worker isolation, light theme. 13 of 14 tests passed. All core role-based features working correctly.

issues: Dashboard content still uses dark theme classes (bg-churvox-card etc) while sidebar is light - intentional per agent context

WORKER ISOLATION: Worker navigates to /dashboard → redirected to /worker/jobs ✓
WORKER ISOLATION: Worker navigates to /clients → redirected to /worker/jobs ✓
WORKER ISOLATION: Worker navigates to /invoices → redirected to /worker/jobs ✓
WORKER JOB DETAIL: Worker clicks job card → /worker/jobs/:id with job detail, status buttons (in_progress, paused, completed), notes ✓

critical_code_review_comments: lib/roles.js: normalizeRole correctly maps employer→owner, admin→owner, worker→worker, manager→manager, office_admin→office_admin, payroll→payroll
lib/roles.js: ROUTE_ACCESS matrix correctly defines access for all routes including plans (owner-only), payroll (owner, manager, payroll)
App.js: BusinessRoute, OwnerRoute, WorkerRoute, PayrollRoute, TeamRoute guards implemented correctly
Layout.js: Light theme sidebar with bg-white, role badge displays normalizedRole, canAccess() used for nav visibility
AuthContext.js: normalizedRole, isOwnerUser, isWorker, isPayroll computed correctly from user.role
WorkerJobsPage.js: Light theme worker jobs list with Settings link to /worker/settings
WorkerJobDetailPage.js: Light theme job detail with status buttons, worker notes, employer notes (read-only)
WorkerSettingsPage.js: Worker settings with profile info and Sign Out button

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 verified full 3-phase launch: (1) Role system with owner/manager/office_admin/worker/payroll roles working correctly, (2) Route protection with BusinessRoute, OwnerRoute, WorkerRoute, PayrollRoute, TeamRoute guards, (3) Worker isolation - worker redirected from /dashboard, /clients, /invoices to /worker/jobs, (4) Worker pages (WorkerJobsPage, WorkerJobDetailPage, WorkerSettingsPage) all working with light theme, (5) Payroll page accessible to owner with Timesheets/Pay Summary cards, (6) Light theme sidebar (white background) confirmed, (7) Role badge shows normalized role in sidebar. Team invite role dropdown exists in code but couldn't test UI due to Solo plan restriction.
